methods.description: Fit to observed rows; draw coefficients only, without bootstrap or residual noise.
Bootstrap-resampled fitting with posterior coefficient sampling disabled.
Bootstrap PMM candidate with a conditional BayesianRidge coefficient draw.

ablation_role: diagnostic only; not part of the primary confirmatory ranking

pmm_candidate.posterior_hyperparameters: empirical-Bayes alpha_ and lambda_ held fixed
pmm_candidate.intercept_prior: same empirical-Bayes coefficient prior as other columns
pmm_candidate.donor_pool: bootstrap copies with originally observed target values
pmm_candidate.donor_distance: absolute conditional-prediction difference after predictor standardization
pmm_candidate.insufficient_donor_rule: fail if fewer than donor_count bootstrap donor records
pmm_candidate.experimental_claim: candidate only; not classified as statistically proper

real_data_extension.expected_cells: derive from run_config and reconcile against raw.csv; never hardcode

evaluation.coverage_among_finite_intervals: covered valid finite intervals / valid finite intervals
evaluation.coverage_interval: two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson exact binomial interval per cell
evaluation.no_missing_gate: pass iff nominal 0.95 lies inside the two-sided exact 95% Clopper-Pearson interval; compatibility check only, not proof of calibration
evaluation.failure_rate: failed runs + invalid intervals + undefined intervals / scheduled runs
evaluation.all_scheduled_operational_success_adjust: covered valid finite intervals / scheduled runs
evaluation.primary_comparison_rule: report each DGP x mechanism x rate x estimand x method cell with its exact Monte Carlo interval; method contrasts are paired replicate-level differences; do not aggregate cells or claim superiority/equivalence without a prespecified margin, weights, and multiplicity rule

robust_inference_validation.ols_within_imputation_variance: HC3 sandwich slope variance from each completed-data fit
robust_inference_validation.interpretation: Barnard-Rubin df adjustment does not by itself guarantee valid robust-HC3 inference

pmm_diagnostics.distance_units: target-variable units; absolute conditional-prediction difference after within-donor-pool predictor standardization
pmm_diagnostics.distance_outlier_rule: above Q3 + 1.5 * IQR within an imputation
pmm_diagnostics.donor_reuse: track bootstrap-copy and original source-row usage separately

synthetic_conditional_diagnostics.scope: known-DGP synthetic data only; never presented as real-data performance
reports: conditional-mean bias and RMSE by x1 quantile region

dgp_parameters: TODO: freeze in reviewed protocol before any experiment
